title: Container Bookings: No-Show Closure and the No-Show Fee
content:
A Container Bookings booking whose sailing leaves without any of its laden containers is closed by the system as a no-show. This page sets out when that happens and what it costs.

## Policy clause

Should the allocated sailing leave port while the booking still stands at confirmed or equipment released, no laden container has come through the terminal gate in time for the cargo cut-off, and the system then closes the booking as a no-show. Its status becomes cancelled and its cancellation date is set to the departure date. A no-show fee is then entered, equal to the product's no-show rate multiplied by the number of containers booked, and the entry names the sailing that was missed.

Whether a sailing was missed is judged by the sailing standing on the booking at the moment of departure. A booking moved off a sailing by a roll before that sailing left did not miss it. Where the customer itself cancelled the booking while the sailing was still alongside, the booking cannot be a no-show, and the cancellation fee is the charge that applies to it.

The no-show fee can be entered only against a booking that already shows the status cancelled. One booking can hold a single no-show fee at most, and a booking holding a cancellation fee cannot hold a no-show fee as well, nor the reverse. No-show fees feed the customer's portfolio no-show record, and the only relief available on them is a goodwill waiver under the goodwill rules.

## Positive and negative cases (hypothetical)

| Situation at departure of the allocated sailing | No-show? |
|---|---|
| Booking confirmed, nothing gated in | Yes |
| Empties released, nothing laden gated in | Yes |
| Laden containers gated in | No |
| Booking rolled to a later sailing before this one left | No, for this sailing |
| Booking cancelled by the customer beforehand | No; the cancellation fee applies instead |

## Worked example (hypothetical rate)

For an invented no-show rate of 320.00 and a booking of 3 containers, the fee entered is 960.00, carrying the vessel and voyage that sailed without the cargo. If the same booking already held a cancellation fee, no no-show fee could be entered on it.
